name: Tech System Overhaul
desc: Live patch shipped 28 Sep 2026 (3.0.x): progression moves from level/phase gates to exploration. Characters start with basic tech unlocked. Future unlocks are not limited by scenario phase or character level.

name: Tech branch: Survival
desc: One of four rebuilt branches (Survival, Production, Combat, Building). Covers field survival unlocks discovered while exploring, not by hitting a level cap.

name: Tech branch: Production
desc: Crafting and facility unlocks. Cultural artifacts brought to the Synthesis Bench can reverse-engineer into recipes or tech points.

name: Tech branch: Combat
desc: Combat tech branch in the rebuilt tree. Unlocks are exploration-driven rather than scenario-phase locked.

name: Tech branch: Building
desc: Building tech branch. Terrain Modifier (Eternaland Shop) is a separate building tool for reshaping terrain, not a tech-tree node.

name: Reverse Engineering
desc: Collect facilities and items marked as cultural artifacts in the wilderness, then process them at the Synthesis Bench. Can unlock crafting or grant Tech Points.

name: Terrain Modifier
desc: Purchased in the Eternaland Shop. Place on the hotbar to reshape terrain (flatten or raise). Separate from the tech tree overhaul.
